text.p: QuadraMed Corp said on Monday its president and chief operating officer, Robert Burrows, would resign and Chairman and Chief Executive Officer James Durham would assume the president's title.

The company also said Fred Stodolak had assumed the position of division president of value-added systems. Stodolak was founder and CEO of Healthcare Design Systems, which QuadraMed acquired in December 1995.
Kevin Arner was named division president of EDI Systems, the company said. Arner had been president of InterMed Healthcare Systems Inc, which QuadraMed acquired in December 1996, it said.
The company was not immediately available to comment on why Burrows resigned.
Burrows' resignation was part of the company's divisional restructuring, the company later said. It said the resignation was voluntary.
